{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check dtype of revenue
print(f"Revenue column dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Check if revenue contains commas
print("First 10 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for '999999.99' rows
test_order_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = '999999.99': {test_order_count}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Confirm the data has no commas in the sample
# But also check for commas in other rows
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"Any revenue values contain commas? {has_commas}")"}
